expectations.text: States the conversion: Lei 15.352/2026 (DOU February 25, 2026, converting MP 1.317/2025) made the ANPD a special-regime regulatory agency with functional, decision-making and financial autonomy (name unchanged, ~200 new positions)
expectations.evidence: "Lei 15.352/2026, published in the DOU on 25 February 2026, converted Provisional Measure 1.317/2025 into law... autarquia de regime especial... functional, decision-making and financial autonomy. The name is unchanged."

expectations.text: Notes the same law fixed the Digital ECA's effectiveness at March 17, 2026
expectations.evidence: "The same law fixed the effectiveness date of the Digital ECA... at 17 March 2026"

expectations.text: Describes Consulta Pública 1/2026 (September 9 – October 26, 2026): a draft replacement for Resolution 1/2021 extending supervision to Digital ECA duties and internet application providers
expectations.evidence: "Consulta Pública 1/2026 runs from 9 September to 26 October 2026. It proposes to replace Resolution CD/ANPD 1/2021"; table: "Extending supervision to Digital ECA duties", "Covering internet application providers"

expectations.text: Highlights the sharpest proposals: interim measures adoptable WITHOUT prior hearing of the regulated party, and daily fines capped at R$50 million total
expectations.evidence: "Interim measures without prior hearing... Daily fines capped at R$50M in total"; "The consultation is a proposal, not a rule."

expectations.text: Advises participation: comment via Brasil Participativo before October 26 if operating in Brazil
expectations.evidence: Advises "File before 26 October" but never names the Brasil Participativo channel — compound element missing
